variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity redesign concept of the RaceSide Formula 1 desktop homepage, using the most recent screenshot as a layout, brand and content reference. Output one crisp 1600 x 1000 horizontal UI screen, no monitor frame, no perspective, no explanatory labels, no variant title.
VARIANT A: SOFT SURFACES. The goal is to make existing blocks MUCH less conspicuous while preserving the existing three-column composition, content density and recognizable RaceSide identity. This is an existing motorsport product, not a landing page.
Keep left navigation at about 230px, center about 850px and right rail about 360px. Preserve the existing red ribbon S RaceSide logo and Russian descriptor exactly from reference, no logo redesign. Keep dark obsidian background #0B0B0B and Geist-style sans typography, readable white text, neutral gray secondary text, Ferrari red #E10600 for purposeful accents only. Remove decorative page glow.
Retain the unframed hero: on the left heading "Гран-при Сингапура", subtitle "Marina Bay Street Circuit", "9–11 октября 2026", next practice "Практика 1", "пт, 9 окт., 11:30", weather "32 °C", "Морось". On right of hero a handsome dark three-dimensional relief globe with red routes and Singapore marked, no surrounding frame. Hero and globe must not overlap text. CTA "Перейти к этапу".
Below hero retain five session columns with "Практика 1" 11:30; "Спринт-квалификация" 15:30; "Спринт" 12:00; "Квалификация" 16:00; "Гонка" 15:00. Convert five separate boxes to ONE subtle continuous background strip #101010, no outer border, no shadows, tiny neutral vertical dividers only. Mark upcoming practice by small red underline and clear text. Keep weather icons and dates.
Right rail: past race report "Отчет прошлого Гран-при", "Гран-при Малайзии", a compact podium with the same order as screenshot: A. Antonelli second, M. Verstappen first, L. Hamilton third. Retain small round driver portraits and podium graphic, but use muted silver, gold and bronze bars, no glow. Button "Открыть полный отчет" red without shadow. Report sits on almost imperceptible #101010 flat surface, with NO border and NO shadow. Leave 28px before next group.
Right rail standings "Личный зачет": six readable rows 1 Andrea Kimi Antonelli 320 Mercedes; 2 George Russell 236 Mercedes; 3 Lewis Hamilton 214 Ferrari; 4 Charles Leclerc 191 Ferrari; 5 Lando Norris 188 McLaren; 6 Max Verstappen 188 Red Bull. No bordered rank badges, no header sub-card. Plain rank numerals, team color dots, points right aligned, only faint horizontal rules. Standings share a very low contrast flat tint, no enclosing stroke or shadow. Action "Подробнее" as quiet text arrow.
Below session strip news heading "Свежие новости" sits directly above a shared subtle surface with two rows, no header border or icon square. First story "Что показал Гран-при Малайзии: проблемы в дождь, успех Red Bull и вопросы к командам" with small race photo on right and compact 2-line excerpt, source "The Race · 2 ч назад". Second story "Расселлу могут грозить два штрафа на стартовой решётке подряд", photo on right, source "The Race · 3 ч назад". No badge outlines. No individual news cards.
Sidebar preserve nav: "Новости", "Соцсети", "Чемпионат", "Пилоты", "Команды", "Календарь", "Текущий этап", "Телеметрия", "Фэнтези лига". Standard thin icons. Next session info has only a quiet surface, no border. Theme toggle and account at bottom, generic label "Мой профиль" rather than a personal name. Hide admin-only navigation. Do not invent extra features.
Typography and alignment provide grouping, section headings integrated into surfaces without square icon backgrounds. Moderate 24–32px gaps. Panels retain subtle background grouping but their boundaries should recede dramatically. Avoid glassmorphism, blur, large rounded rectangles, heavy borders, shadows, purple/blue glow. Produce a realistic shippable app design with meticulous Russian text, no nonsense text, not a collage.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE exceptionally crisp high-fidelity RaceSide desktop homepage redesign as a 1600 x 1000 horizontal app screenshot. Use the most recent actual homepage screenshot as the brand and content reference, not as a pixel-locked edit. No monitor frame, no perspective, no collage, no explanatory annotations.
VARIANT B: OPEN CANVAS. The user's request is to make block boundaries disappear. This direction must look clearly MORE seamless and visually different from a softened card dashboard. Every section is composed DIRECTLY on the SAME flat #0B0B0B background. ZERO enclosing cards around hero, schedule, report, standings or news. NO rounded panel backgrounds, NO panel outlines, NO panel shadows, NO glass, NO gradient. Hierarchy comes from 32–44px negative space, compact confident sans headings, alignment and a few thin separators. Keep Geist-like UI typography. White primary text, legible gray secondary text, restrained Ferrari red #E10600. Keep familiar motorsport product density, not a marketing website.
Layout: left 220px navigation, main 900px and narrow right rail 340px. Sidebar separated only by one very faint vertical rule. Copy approved red S ribbon logo + RaceSide wordmark and "Гоночный центр" descriptor from reference faithfully. Sidebar next-session text is unframed: "Следующая сессия", "Практика 1", "Гран-при Сингапура", red "Через 3 дн. 15 ч". Same navigation thin icons and labels "Новости", "Соцсети", "Чемпионат", "Пилоты", "Команды", "Календарь", "Текущий этап", "Телеметрия", "Фэнтези лига". Bottom theme switch and "Мой профиль". No admin entry, no personal name.
Main hero flows on black page: modest metadata "Раунд 17 · Сезон 2026", large but controlled "Гран-при Сингапура" on 2 lines, "Marina Bay Street Circuit", "9–11 октября 2026", next practice 11:30 Friday 9 October, 32°C and "Морось", compact clearly clickable button "Перейти к этапу". Hero right a gorgeous realistic dark relief season globe with cold rim light on sphere, red route lines, Singapore highlighted; no surrounding halo, no framing. This globe remains the single main visual, not too big, no text overlap.
Under hero FIVE unboxed session columns on the page background, no shared schedule panel either. Thin short dividers can separate columns. Active practice gets tiny red dot and short red underline, not a box. Session text in sentence case: "Практика 1" / 11:30 / "пт, 9 окт."; "Спринт-квалификация" / 15:30 / "пт, 9 окт."; "Спринт" / 12:00 / "сб, 10 окт."; "Квалификация" / 16:00 / "сб, 10 окт."; "Гонка" / 15:00 / "вс, 11 окт.". Small weather icons and temperatures. This entire strip must read as a continuous rhythm across the page.
Right rail report on the SAME black background: heading "Отчет прошлого Гран-при", "Гран-при Малайзии", "вс, 4 окт., 10:00". Simplify podium into three small aligned circular portraits with result numerals and driver names underneath, center winner a little higher. Left "2 · A. Antonelli", center "1 · M. Verstappen", right "3 · L. Hamilton"; Mercedes, Red Bull and Ferrari tiny contextual team dots. Remove big gold/silver/bronze podium rectangles. A compact red "Открыть полный отчет" button, not a full giant action bar. Report has NO perimeter, NO surface contrast, NO header divider.
Below with 40px gap: "Личный зачет", small slide counter "01 / 02", six rows with ranks, names, teams and points: 1 Andrea Kimi Antonelli Mercedes 320; 2 George Russell Mercedes 236; 3 Lewis Hamilton Ferrari 214; 4 Charles Leclerc Ferrari 191; 5 Lando Norris McLaren 188; 6 Max Verstappen Red Bull 188. NO rank badges or individual row boxes. Small team color dots, neutral rank numbers, aligned points. Only occasional subtle hairlines at 4% white. "Подробнее →" as text link. Entire right column should feel like a margin of the same page, not a stack of widgets.
Under schedule with 36px breathing room: standalone "Свежие новости" heading and "Все новости →" aligned opposite. Two open article rows with NO panels, no filled backgrounds or outline badges, a small landscape race image at right. First "Что показал Гран-при Малайзии: проблемы в дождь, успех Red Bull и вопросы к командам", metadata "The Race · 2 ч назад", excerpt "Возвращение Формулы-1 на Сепанг выявило проблемы машин в дождь." Second "Расселлу могут грозить два штрафа на стартовой решётке подряд", metadata "The Race · 3 ч назад", excerpt "Mercedes выясняет причину отказа силовой установки в Малайзии." Do not invent editorial claims. Headlines 18–20px, metadata 13px, excerpts 15px. Photos rectangular with 4px radius, integrated into list rhythm.
Make the eye flow from Singapore hero into schedule and news without seeing container edges. Consistent baseline grid, exact readable Cyrillic. Clear click affordances for buttons, preserve contrast of text. No gigantic blank spaces, no decorative large numerals, no cards-inside-cards. This is a usable coherent motorsport dashboard with invisible section containers.
